name: Thames Path
description_md:
The Thames Path is a national waymarked hiking route located in GB. This trail covers a distance of 312.7 km and is signposted as TP.

The route is classified as hard due to the distance and 496 m of ascent. It involves 602 m of descent and requires about 80 hours of walking time based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes within 700 m of London Gatwick, London Heathrow, and London Luton.
